facts.summary: Halted development after no meaningful HBsAg reduction at projected efficacious dose · Phase 1 · ALG-010133 in chronic hepatitis B · not yet approved

evidence.summary: at the projected efficacious dose (400 mg, estimated to achieve liver exposures >3 x EC90 for HBsAg inhibition) there is no meaningful HBsAg reduction.
evidence.primary_endpoint_met: higher doses levels (maximum feasible dose is 600 mg) that were planned to be evaluated in a subsequent cohort are very unlikely to reach the 1 log10 IU/mL HBsAg reduction level that the Company had previously defined as necessary to advance the program.
evidence.safety: No dose limiting safety findings have been identified in CHB subjects dosed at any dose level.
evidence.program_discontinued: these data were not sufficient to support further development of ALG-010133 and that dosing should be discontinued.
